text: Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. The free half-hours on my calendar are Monday 14:00-14:30, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 and Wednesday 10:00-10:30. Would Monday 14:00-14:30 suit you? Tell me which works and I'll put it on my calendar.

Hi Professor Alvarez — Monday 14:00-14:30 doesn't work for me: my Study group runs to 14:10 and the Seminar starts at 14:10. Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is free (it sits right before your CSE455 office hours), so let's take that. I've put it on my calendar as the CSE455 staff meeting. Wednesday 10:00-10:30 would also have worked, but Tuesday is my first choice.
Tuesday 15:00-15:30 it is — I've booked it as the CSE455 staff meeting and logged it. See you then.
